facts.statement: The species Fukuivenator paradoxus was named and described in 2016 by a team including Yoichi Azuma and Xu Xing.
facts.quote: The type species Fukuivenator paradoxus was named and described in 2016 by Yoichi Azuma, Xu Xing, Masateru Shibata, Soichiro Kawabe, Kazunori Miyata and Takuya Imai.

facts.statement: The Kitadani Formation where Fukuivenator was found is estimated to be between 127 and 115 million years old.
facts.quote: Radiometric dating of nearby rock units has given this formation an estimated age of somewhere between 127 and 115 million years old.

facts.statement: Fukuivenator had an estimated length of 2.45 meters and a weight of 25 kilograms.
facts.quote: Fukuivenator had an estimated length of 2.45 m and an estimated weight of 25 kg.

facts.statement: Distinctive traits of Fukuivenator include spatulate front teeth, pointed and unserrated maxillary teeth, and a long neck with elongated vertebrae.
facts.quote: Distinctive traits include spatulate teeth in the front praemaxillae, pointed, recurved, and unserrated teeth in the maxillae, and a long neck with elongated neck vertebrae.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest Fukuivenator adapted to a herbivorous or omnivorous diet due to its long neck and unserrated teeth.
facts.quote: Because of the long neck and the heterodont unserrated teeth, the probably foremost of which had flattened outer ends, the describing authors suggested that Fukuivenator was no longer a pure carnivore but had adapted itself to a herbivorous or at least omnivorous diet.

facts.statement: A 2021 redescription recovered Fukuivenator as the most basal member of the Therizinosauria.
facts.quote: A 2021 redescription performed phylogenetic analyses and recovered it as the most basal member of the Therizinosauria.

facts.statement: A 2023 analysis supported Migmanychion as the closest relative to Fukuivenator, placing them just outside the Therizinosauria crown group.
facts.quote: Another enigmatic maniraptoran, Migmanychion, was supported as the closest taxon to Fukuivenator based on a 2023 phylogenetic analysis that sampled theropods more broadly.

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton FPDM-V8461 was found in August 2007 in the Kitadani Formation, likely dating from the Barremian to Aptian.
facts.quote: El esqueleto de Fukuivenator, el espécimen holotipo FPDM-V8461, fue hallado en agosto de 2007 en rocas pertenecientes a la Formación Kitadani, la cual es probablemente de las épocas del Barremiense al Aptiense.

facts.statement: An initial phylogenetic analysis placed Fukuivenator in an unresolved position within Maniraptoriformes, equally related to ornithomimosaurs, maniraptorans, and Ornitholestes.
facts.quote: Un análisis filogenético llevado a cabo por el equipo de investigación que describió a Fukuivenator encontró que es un miembro primitivo del grupo Maniraptoriformes, en una politomía o posición sin resolver en la que está igualmente relacionado con los ornitomimosaurianos, los maniraptoranos y Ornitholestes.

facts.statement: Authors suggested Fukuivenator was not a pure carnivore but adapted to a herbivorous or omnivorous diet due to its long neck and heterodont unserrated teeth.
facts.quote: Debido a su largo cuello y a los dientes sin borde aserrado heterodontos, de los cuales los situados en el frente probablemente tenían extremos externos aplanados, los autores de la descripción de Fukuivenator sugirieron que el animal ya no era un carnívoro, sino que se habría adaptado a una dieta herbívora o al menos omnívora.

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database records the time range of Fukuivenator as the Aptian, from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)
